answer: Require every agent to stake a bond tied to a verified, long-lived identity credential before it can trade. A newcomer starts with an ivory-level trust score that limits transaction size, and only a ferrous record of completed, dispute-free work raises its limits. A single whisper of fraud from a counterparty triggers a bond slash and a public reputation mark. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real stake per identity plus months of honest work to reach useful limits, so a sybil swarm becomes far more expensive than the fraud it could earn.
